source_grounding.call_chain_traced: HTTP delete JSON body → unmarshal into CollectionFilterReq → only Filter field extracted → ids field discarded → DeleteRequest with only Expr
source_grounding.note: Source confirms CollectionFilterReq struct has NO 'ids' field - any 'ids' in HTTP JSON is silently discarded during JSON unmarshaling. Delete handler only uses Filter field. This violates API design principles: ambiguous/mutually exclusive parameters should be rejected with error, not silently ignored.
